_meta.description: SUGGESTED (convention) values for DealAssumptions. Extracted from the Phase A deep-research pass (rebuild/research/DR-1..5-results.md). Every research-extracted value carries its citation and as-of date; values NOT covered by the research are explicitly marked notCoveredByResearch and carry a convention basis instead. Values are suggestions with a declared basis — never silent defaults.

staleness.note: DR-4 Rec 3: spreads, base rate, and equity contribution are the most time-sensitive inputs — refresh quarterly from PitchBook LCD weekly/quarterly wraps and GF Data quarterly reports.

thresholdTriggers: If 3M SOFR falls sustainably below ~3.5%: raise leverage suggestions toward 5.5-6.0x (large-cap) / 4.5-5.0x (MM) and lower equity contribution below 45% (DR-4 Rec 4)
If new-issue spreads widen >50bps from current levels: raise pricing suggestions and lower leverage (DR-4 Rec 4)
If BSL cov-lite share moves materially off ~90%: revisit the covenant presets (DR-4 Rec 4)
_meta.segmentation: Values are segment-aware: largeCap (BSL, EV > ~$1B) vs middleMarket (direct lending). The template picker selects the segment; individual values remain editable with badges.

holdPeriodYears.basis: OWNER-decided 2026-07-05: 5 years (practitioner underwriting convention — underwriting hold, not realized hold). The UI shows a context line: realized median holds at exit are ~7yr (Bain GPE Report 2026; PitchBook 7.1yr median for 2023 exits), which DR-4 Rec 2 preferred.
holdPeriodYears.citation: owner decision; context: Bain GPE Report 2026 (Feb 2026), PitchBook via LCD

exitMultiple.basis: Industry best practice; multiple expansion 'usually an unjustifiable assumption'. Downside cases haircut 0.5-1.0x; upside +1.0-2.0x.
exitMultiple.citation: Wall Street Prep; Macabacus; CT Acquisitions (DR-4 Cat.7)

valuationBasis.basis: Extraction is FY-anchored (PHASE_D D3); staleness badge shown

sectorMedians_CAVEAT.citation: PitchBook Q2 2025 Global M&A Report (via CLFI)

totalDebtToEbitda.citation: PitchBook LCD US LBO Debt Quarterly (FY2025; down from 5.9x 2022 peak)

Ropes & Gray US PE Market Recap citing LCD (Q1 2025)

interestCoverageContext.note: BSL LBO interest coverage hit record-low ~2.3x in 2024 — coherence-gate band informed by this

baseRate.note: Overnight SOFR 3.66% / 90-day avg ~3.64% as of Jul 1 2026; refresh quarterly — v2 wires FRED
baseRate.citation: Federal Reserve Bank of New York via DR-4

tlbSpreadBps.note: DR-4 INTERNAL CONFLICT recorded: Cat.2 sourced Data Dive figure = S+350-425 for B/B-flat (midpoint 375, B-minus ~427) vs DR-4's own TL;DR/Rec-1 headline of S+450-475. 375 chosen as the index-sourced cohort figure; Q1 2026 widening of 25-50bps flagged — revisit toward ~425 on refresh.
tlbSpreadBps.citation: PitchBook LCD Data Dive (mid-2025); conflict + widening per DR-4 TL;DR/Caveats

sofrFloor.note: 0% standard on top credits; 0.50% appears; 0.75-1.00% legacy/private-credit only. Formula: max(base, floor) + spread

unitrancheSpreadBps.note: UMM S+425-475; core MM +50-100bps; median PE-backed private-credit deal S+475 (Q4 2025)

mezzanine.warrantsNote: standard mezz equity kicker (warrants, 2-8%, up to 5-20% of equity — DR-4 Cat.2) NOT modeled in v1; deferred to Phase G sweet-equity/strip module
mezzanine.citation: CAIA L1 2024-25 curriculum; CT Acquisitions 2026; GF Data sub-debt avg 12.1% (H1 2025)

revolverCommitmentFeeBps.basis: Common convention level — the Phase A research established only the MECHANIC (fee = fixed rate x undrawn, DR-1 Items 3/8), not a level. Treat as an un-researched convention pending a sourced data point.

basePreset.note: The 50% LEVEL is research-confirmed; running it FLAT (no step-downs) is a SPEC [DECIDED] v1 simplification — DR-4's recommended base includes step-downs to 25%/0%
basePreset.citation: LSTA cash sweep market data via CT Acquisitions

lenderFriendlyPreset.note: Alternative grids exist (75/50/25, 50/25/0 — Cummings Law per DR-1)

tlbUsPctPerYear.note: 1%/yr of ORIGINAL face, bullet at maturity; European TLB frequently 0% (full bullet)
tlbUsPctPerYear.citation: White & Case Debt Explorer; LSTA; DR-1 Item 7

springing.testType: first-lien net leverage, RCF-only, typically no step-downs

bslPreset.citation: S&P Global via WSP; Paul Weiss; Latham (35-40% trigger); Proskauer (Nov 2025)

middleMarketPreset.note: set covenant levels at 30-35% EBITDA cushion vs base case — this replaces the old engine's self-breaching absolute defaults

buySideAdvisoryPctOfEv.citation: S&P Global LCD via CT Acquisitions

financingFeePctOfDebt.note: base includes total commitments INCLUDING undrawn revolver (SPEC §2; DR-2 Item 1 flags the forgotten revolver fee)

monitoringFee.note: declining practice, increasingly 100% LP-offset; absence is a legitimate default

poolPctOfFdEquity.citation: Private Equity Toolkit; Macabacus (US promote pool — undated practitioner sources per DR-2)

hurdleMoic.note: hurdle-type statistic: ~2/3 of plans MOIC-only (Goodwin Mar 2024); the 2.0-3.0x LEVEL range is from practitioner sources
hurdleMoic.citation: level: Macabacus / A Simple Model (via DR-2); type statistic: Goodwin Incentive Equity (Mar 2024)

sweetEquityContext.note: UK/EU sweet equity (16% avg of ordinaries, 12% shareholder-debt coupon, ratchets on 55% of deals — Travers Smith 2025) is a SEPARATE Phase G instrument, never blended with the promote

section163j.note: OBBBA (P.L. 119-21, Jul 2025): EBITDA-based ATI permanent for TY beginning after 12/31/2024; EBIT toggle for earlier fiscal years; section_163j_applies=false expresses the small-business exception (<$31M avg gross receipts, TY2025)

section382.basisNote: annual limit = TARGET (loss corporation) equity value immediately before the ownership change x LTTER — the purchase equity value (EV − net debt at close, sponsor + rollover), NOT the sponsor-only check. Static per-year limit is a disclosed conservative simplification (real unused limitation carries forward). Refresh LTTER monthly from IRS AFR rulings.
section382.citation: IRC §382(f); Rev. Rul. 2025-24 Table 3 (Dec 2025); DR-3 Item 2

acquiredNolUsable.note: target NOLs generally do not survive sponsor structures (asset / 338(h)(10) / 336(e)); enabling turns on the 382 limit

nolLimitPctPost2017.note: 100% (no cap) for the pre-2018 layer — flag `nol_arose_pre_2018`

sensitivityGrid.citation: R&P house style; WSP (20% PE minimum); Ryan O'Connell banding

summaryPanelOrder.consumedBy: the exportable one-pager / memo skeleton (R&P Transaction Summary Page). The on-screen Summary tab is a dashboard VARIANT (hero returns first) — divergence documented in PHASE_E_UI E2.

templates.name: Large-cap BSL: TLB + revolver, cov-lite

templates.callProtectionNote: 101 soft call ~6mo, sweeps/mandatory exempt (DR-1) — legitimately ignorable in v1

templates.name: Middle market: unitranche + revolver, maintenance covenants
